evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/f implements Gson JsonSerializer<Color> and JsonDeserializer<Color>; it reads integer field 'value' into java.awt.Color and writes 'value'=getRGB() plus 'falpha'=0.0.
RuneLite ColorTypeAdapter uses the same java.awt.Color Gson adapter contract and exact JSON shape, including 'value' and 'falpha'.
ColorTypeAdapter is stronger historical source identity than the earlier descriptive R82 name ColorGsonAdapter.

candidates.note: R82 corrected from descriptive ColorGsonAdapter to historical RuneLite source identity ColorTypeAdapter.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/o conditionally enables Apple native fullscreen, installs the fullscreen adapter, requests user attention and forces application foreground/focus.
Diagnostics include 'Enabled fullscreen on macOS', 'Requested user attention on macOS' and 'Forced focus on macOS'.
Historical RuneLite OSXUtil contains the same Apple EAWT helper surface and exact fullscreen diagnostic, making OSXUtil stronger than the earlier descriptive R82 name MacOSWindowUtil.

candidates.note: R82 corrected from descriptive MacOSWindowUtil to historical RuneLite source identity OSXUtil.
